name: Featherfall - Be Bird
summary:
# Play as a Bird

Step into the wings of a bird and experience flight like never before. Flap, glide, dive, and perch using natural VR movements - every motion mapped to your body for a fully immersive, embodied flying experience. Fly freely across open skies and explore the world at your own pace.
